title: Normalized integral encodings and operation endpoints
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], so $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$ be an open/proper factorization of a $k$-morphism. Fix $d\in\mathbb N$, a field-shriek model system $D$, a finite coefficient subfield $E$, and an integral model $m$ of [def-sp-field-extension-integral-models]. Use the integral and condensed full finite-Tor constructible subcategories, their inclusions, and the literal restricted ambient compact-support and twisted-pullback functors of [def-pur-integral-counit-realization-data]. There exist equivalences $e_X,e_Y$ from the integral to the condensed categories whose composites with the inclusions are naturally isomorphic to inclusion followed by the specified normalized internalization. Both the literal condensed compact-support functor and the literal pullback/Tate-tensor/$[2d]$ functor preserve those full subcategories. For their restrictions $F,J$ there are natural isomorphisms $F_m e_Y\simeq e_X F$ and $J_m e_X\simeq e_Y J$. No adjunction or unit/counit comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Restrict the normalized ordinary/internal coefficient equivalences to the full integral constructible finite-Tor categories. The integral-model criterion identifies membership in both directions, including derived completeness; the resulting inclusion comparisons are the specified internalizations.

The actual proper/open direct-image comparison and the pullback/tensor comparison intertwine the ambient operations under these equivalences. Restrict them to the full subcategories. Preservation by the recorded integral operations gives condensed membership, and the restricted comparisons give the two endpoint isomorphisms.

theorem condensed_integral_endpoints (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P)
    (m : FieldExtensionTowers.IntegralModel P D E j p d) :
    ∃ (eX : FieldExtensionTowers.Integral P E X ≌ Condensed P E X)
      (eY : FieldExtensionTowers.Integral P E Y ≌ Condensed P E Y),
      Nonempty (eX.functor ⋙ condensedInclusion P E X ≅
        (sfIntegralConstructible P.coefficients.l E.val X).ι ⋙
          (RationalizedSmoothAdjunction.internalization P.coefficients.l E.val X
            ((D.coordinates E).abelian X) m.reductionX).functor) ∧
      Nonempty (eY.functor ⋙ condensedInclusion P E Y ≅
        (sfIntegralConstructible P.coefficients.l E.val Y).ι ⋙
          (RationalizedSmoothAdjunction.internalization P.coefficients.l E.val Y
            ((D.coordinates E).abelian Y) m.reductionY).functor) ∧
      ∃ (hF : ∀ M : Condensed P E X,
          (constantModelBoundedConstructible (spIntegralCondensed P.coefficients.l E.val) Y ⊓
            fun K ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K)
            ((IntegralDirectImageTower.shriek P.coefficients.l E.val
              (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)).obj ((condensedInclusion P E X).obj M)))
        (hJ : ∀ K : Condensed P E Y,
          (constantModelBoundedConstructible (spIntegralCondensed P.coefficients.l E.val) X ⊓
            fun L ↦ _root_.DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ L)
            ((condensedSource P D j p d E m).obj ((condensedInclusion P E Y).obj K))),
        Nonempty (FieldExtensionTowers.support P D j p d m ⋙ eY.functor ≅
          eX.functor ⋙ condensedRestriction P E
            (IntegralDirectImageTower.shriek P.coefficients.l E.val
              (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)) hF) ∧
        Nonempty (FieldExtensionTowers.puritySource P D j p d m ⋙ eX.functor ≅
          eY.functor ⋙ condensedRestriction P E (condensedSource P D j p d E m) hJ)
